title: Observability: raw wolfCrypt error code not logged before errno translation
description: The provider contract (crypto2dev_provider.h) requires providers to translate wolfCrypt error codes to kernel errno before returning. The framework logs the translated ret value only. If a provider silently maps wolfCrypt BAD_FUNC_ARG (-173) or KEY_NO_DEVICE_E to -EINVAL without first emitting pr_err with the original code, the raw wolfCrypt error is lost. A support engineer cannot distinguish a FIPS-operational refusal (which should map to -EACCES) from a parameter error (-EINVAL) from a wolfCrypt internal error — all appear identical in dmesg. The provider interface contract should require providers to log the raw wolfCrypt error code before returning, or the framework should accept a separate out-param for the raw error.
